title: Not a tool for anyone: power tools that protect the individual's sovereignty; imagine AI is fire, and learn when it is useful (2026-11-06)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
Additctive technology makes everything as easy as possible. It removes individuality, it removes friction and the need to think. Our goal it not to build a tool for anyone. Our goal is to build a tool that people recognise as something different. Our tools protect the soverignty of the individual. We are against "enshittification". We build the tools that empower people, rather than taking away their power. 

VIM, EMACs these are power tools. They are not easy tools. But they have remains useful to many. We don't want to take that level of extreme, but we want to find a way to manage the human-ai future. This means that we need to learn to use tools wisely. 

My analogy is to say "imagine AI is fire" . If a society discovered fire, there would be all sorts of people exploreing ways to use fire for everything. Fire cults. Cure cures. Fire tools. Fire art. Houses, cities and forests would burn. Many would say "No Fire!". But the way forward is to learn when fire is useful.
